cards.title: Skerry Light
cards.blurb: You keep the light on a bare rock in the North Atlantic. By day haul the tide nets and set walls, nets and screens to the quarter each dawn forecasts; by night the breakers land, and what the walls cannot turn goes into the tower. When the light goes out, the logbook buys what the next keeper knows.

shots.beat: Day three: screens behind the side tonight's spray will strike
Night seven: the storm comes through the walls
The light goes out: the logbook pays

cards.title: The Walled Garden
cards.blurb: Every evening the pests come through the gap in the garden wall and make for the seedbed. By day you plant box hedges to send them the long way round, and along the path whatever answers the night ahead: thrushes for slugs, bats for the moths that fly over it all, ladybirds for greenfly. Then night falls, and you watch.

cards.title: Spoor
cards.blurb: You are the last huntsman of a lodge at the edge of the Hartwold, a fogged forest said to hold the Pale Hart. Walk it one tile at a time on jerky and water, hunt what you find, and carry it home: a fall out there loses the haul and the ground you charted. Take the dens' trophies, refit for the Fen, the Snowfield and the Deepwood, and track the Hart to its lair.

shots.beat: The forest kit: the first camp raised
The Mere Wolf taken: the Fen's meres open
Three trophies and the sledge, camped below the Deepwood

cards.title: The Aluminium Empire
cards.blurb: In 1855 aluminium comes cheap, forty years early, and the Second Empire builds aeroplanes. Raise timber yards and bauxite pits at Le Bourget, patent the workshops that turn them into spars, engines and monoplanes, and keep the compagnons seated and fed through the seasons. Then stage an Exposition Universelle, fill the Ministry of War's orders, and play for the Grand Prix of 1867.

shots.beat: The first aeroplane: every workshop on the drawing inked
After the first Exposition: a Ministry of War order on the books
Every charter granted, and Le Contremaître employed

cards.title: Lights Out
cards.blurb: Inmate 4471 relives the same night in Blackwater Penitentiary. At lights-out you write the plan, from bending a wire into a pick to boarding the freight, and the plan runs until your Nerve breaks. You wake in the cell again with what the night taught you, and the plan gets you out a little faster.
credits: Kenney Future Narrow font: Kenney · CC BY-SA 3.0

shots.beat: Night 4: the plan into the laundry
Night 9: over the wall, the milk truck pays
Night 18: out on the freight, racing the splits

cards.title: Hardpoint
cards.blurb: A drone swarm presses the breach line, and you are the fitter aboard the frigate Hardpoint. The guns fire on their own; you plate out the hull and fit each module where its neighbours make it worth most. Break each sector's carrier inside thirty seconds of fire, then recommission into the lancer Longreach and the flagship Sovereign.

shots.beat: The frigate: Railgun schematic recovered
The cruiser keel plated: the breach line opens
Sovereign: the Breach Mother destroyed, the Dreadnought ahead

cards.title: Night Clerk
cards.blurb: A box with no label comes down the chute at 2:14 a.m.: the file on a woman who vanished in 1979. Read it, hire clerks, pin the cards to a wall, then post the clerks on the night's watches. Each door you open retires what you did before it.

shots.beat: Phase I: eight clerks reading the box
Phase II: the board at 4×4
Phase III: two alibis hold

cards.title: Consolidated Holdings
cards.blurb: You found a holding company on one pushcart and close its deals by hand. Buy newsstands, diners and mills on up to savings banks, each seller asking more than the last, then hire a sales desk, an acquisitions desk and a board to run the firm for you. Keep an eye on the wire for tips, and grow until the firm can buy the tallest building in town.

shots.beat: Two minutes in: the sales desk takes over the deals
The first savings bank, with the executive floor hired
The Consolidated Building goes up for sale

cards.title: Paragon
cards.blurb: You run a hero corps over a comic-book city at night, and the heroes earn Justice on their own. Reboot the timeline for Legacy, rewrite the multiverse for Continuity, then turn the Age for Canon: each layer wipes the one below it and hands it to automation. Between resets, Elseworlds run the corps under worse rules for permanent rewards.
credits: Kenney Thick and Kenney Bold fonts: Kenney · CC BY-SA 3.0

shots.beat: The first timeline: the corps, its first Reboot ready
Villain Uprising: an Elseworld after two Rewrites

cards.title: Inkfist Dojo
cards.blurb: You are an old master who can no longer fight, so you write kata: scrolls of moves your student performs one line per beat. Each challenger at the gate brings a pattern the old scroll cannot answer, and the word that answers it goes on the shelf. You never press strike; the scroll is the only verb.

shots.beat: Ox-Hide Ren's rematch: the fist is tempered
Four graduations on, the scroll parries Brother Gang
The Envoy's Gauntlet: one scroll names each challenger

cards.title: Chrome & Cantrip
cards.blurb: Rain on the sprawl, and the old ley lines awake under its streets. Hire hustlers for scrip, sink taps for aether, and train Razorboys, Hexers and Riggers to send into three districts a rival crew wants too. Hold one, order the assault, and burn their safehouse before they burn yours.
credits: City and defense models: Kenney · CC0
Crew figures and their animations: Kay Lousberg · CC0
Kenney Future Square and Kenney High fonts: Kenney · CC BY-SA 3.0

shots.beat: Neon Narrows answers to your crew
The syndicate charter: the crew goes tier two
The assault: their safehouse at half

cards.title: One More Take
cards.blurb: You are the stunt double on an action set that never wraps. The effects crew fires your rigs on their own clocks while extras pour in from every side; all you choose is where to stand. Bank the reels the fallen drop, take the writers' pages, and hold the floor until the lead falls and someone calls CUT.

shots.beat: Rated G: the Pyro improvises the take

cards.title: Hold the Causeway
cards.blurb: Fairhold and a neighbouring lord's keep face each other across a causeway one road wide. Raise yeomen, bowmen, knights and a mangonel, sound your horn to send them out in ranks, and hold the line past the middle so your engines can reach his gate. Every battle, won or lost, goes into the Chronicle, whose boons carry you up a march of fifteen fields to the Usurper's throne.

shots.beat: Grubb's Ford: yeomen against yeomen on the causeway
The Mudhole: the line held past the middle, a mangonel at the gate
Camp: Dunmarrow's keep taken, Lady Vesk next on the march
